p2aWeakness.behavior: a caller-supplied classification hint recorded verbatim by the port; P2-A's own gate passed FIRST_PARTY_DSH_QUALIFIED itself
p2aWeakness.consequence: the label was not independent verification of the executable's provenance

trustedSourceChain: the Parent owns the ChildProcess spawn
the Parent receives a strict IPC report on that child's channel
Work Delegation supplies the canonical AttemptId
the execution source is qualified through the deployment's OWN TrustedSourceBasis (a digest of the configured worker bin, its basename, and the node executable)
the real DSH Session header is read through the official source adapter

enforcement.recorderBoundToDeploymentBasis: createExecutionAssociationRecorder stamps the deployment's own basis; it cannot upgrade its kind from an observation
enforcement.readSideComparesVerifierBasis: makeAssociationQualifier refuses a record whose sourceBasis does not match the verifier's own, regardless of what the record declares
enforcement.declaredLabelNeverConsulted: sourceQualificationDeclared is preserved for audit only

honestLimit: this is a defensible LOCAL Host provenance chain, NOT remote cryptographic attestation and NOT hardware identity proof. A caller holding the raw store reference can still write a well-formed record; the read side's basis comparison plus the Work and DSH re-reads are what refuse it.
